name: dsh-plugin-publisher
description: DSH plugin development & GitHub publishing workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). A consent-gated host plugin that registers the `dsh-plugin-publishing` skill — the full workflow for developing a DSH plugin, verifying it, publishing it to GitHub with the `dsh-plugin` topic, and making it visible in the DSH plugin marketplace. The skill is only registered after the user explicitly enables `config.consent`.
